# technitium_settings_web_service (Resource)

Manages the web console/API listener. Changing ports or TLS can cut off the provider's own connection; update the provider `host` accordingly.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_http3` (Boolean) Enable HTTP/3.
- `enable_http_unix_socket` (Boolean) Listen on an HTTP Unix socket.
- `enable_tls` (Boolean) Enable HTTPS.
- `enable_tls_unix_socket` (Boolean) Listen on a TLS Unix socket.
- `http_port` (Number) HTTP port.
- `http_to_tls_redirect` (Boolean) Redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
- `http_unix_socket` (String) HTTP Unix socket path.
- `local_addresses` (List of String) Listen addresses.
- `real_ip_header` (String) Header carrying the client IP from a reverse proxy.
- `reverse_proxy_addresses` (List of String) Reverse proxies whose real-IP header is trusted.
- `tls_certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) Certificate password. Not readable from the server.
- `tls_certificate_path` (String) Path to a PKCS #12 (.pfx) certificate on the server.
- `tls_port` (Number) HTTPS port.
- `tls_unix_socket` (String) TLS Unix socket path.
- `use_self_signed_tls_certificate` (Boolean) Generate a self-signed certificate.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
